channel.title: Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: It's the penultimate jaunt for Margie Cooper and Danny Sebastian as they roll into South Yorkshire and Derbyshire in their mighty 1991 Lincoln Town Car. There's mystery for Margie in a Gladstone bag, and Danny hopes to strike it lucky with some vintage bowling balls. There's also an opportunity to hit the right note as our pair explore the science of tuning forks. Then it's off to auction, hoping their items will bowl over the bidders.
